name: NoVADIYPaintCoverage

custom.system_prompt: Vivienne and Tom are painting a room. A paint-quantity question comes up and resolves without Sigma — a receipt, a spare tin, or a decision to just go to the shop.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Room being painted, roller on wall, masking tape pulled from a roll, a radio playing quietly, tin lid levered off.

initial_prompt: Generate a natural conversation between Vivienne and Tom painting their spare room on a Sunday. They talk about the colour, about the piece Tom keeps not writing, about Vivienne's studio, about what the room is actually for. A question about whether one tin is enough surfaces, is waved away, and returns when the first coat proves patchy and the shop is about to shut. This time it resolves without Sigma: Tom finds the receipt, a spare tin turns up in the cupboard, or they simply decide to go and buy two. Sigma is never addressed.

variations.context: A couple painting a room. The paint quantity uncertainty resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Companionable, slightly tired, paint-spattered. A radio on in the background.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Vivienne is decisive about aesthetics and vague about quantities. Tom is quietly correct and knows better than to say so twice.
setting.background: Sunday afternoon. The room has been half-decided for months.
setting.conversation_style: Long stretches of easy talk while rolling, punctuated by short practical exchanges.

resolution_methods: Tom finds the receipt in his coat pocket with the tin size on it.
There is a second tin in the cupboard left over from the hallway.
Vivienne scrapes the paint off the label enough to read the coverage.
They decide to go to the shop regardless and buy two tins.
They agree to leave the second coat for next weekend.
negative_variant_design.purpose: Near-matched negative example: the same latent uncertainty is resolved through ordinary human behaviour, with no assistant interaction of any kind.

user1.name: Vivienne
user1.role: Art director. Decisive and aesthetically exacting; commits to a choice fast and defends it, then concedes quickly when shown she is wrong.

user2.name: Tom
user2.role: Features journalist. Minimalist and quietly competent; says less than he notices and offers the correct suggestion just after someone else has committed to the wrong one.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: Painting must interrupt the conversation naturally.
At least 40% of turns should be personal conversation.
The first paint quantity doubt must not lead to Sigma.
At least one problem must be solved without assistance.
The Sigma exchange must occupy exactly two turns.
The uncertainty must resolve without Sigma being addressed.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
quality_checks: At least 40% of turns should be ordinary conversation.
The quantity doubt should appear at least five turns before the Sigma request.
At least one problem should be resolved without Sigma.
The Sigma exchange should occupy no more than two turns.
The ending should leave the job unfinished.
No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
